stem.text: An electromagnetic wave is diffracted as it passes through a single slit. The width of the slit is larger than the wavelength of the wave.
Which change will decrease the amount of diffraction of the wave?

A.text: Decrease the frequency of the wave.

B.text: Decrease the time period of the wave.

C.text: Decrease the width of the slit.

D.text: Increase the wavelength of the wave.
